To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) a conceptual model is a description of a system that is independent of any particular implementation, (2) a conceptual model describes the structure and behavior of a system, (3) a conceptual model can be used as a basis for the design of the system, and (4) a conceptual model provides a means for communication between stakeholders of the system.

(1) conceptual modeling is a complex activity that is difficult to study experimentally, (2) the current state-of-practice in the experimental study of conceptual modeling is inadequate, (3) the current state of the practice in the experimental study is inadequate because it is not based on a sound theoretical foundation, and (4) the current state is not adequate because it is based on an inadequate theoretical foundation.
the conceptual modeling of a system can be used as an effective means to improve the quality of a system's design and development.

the design and evaluation of conceptual modeling languages, methods, and tools.
